method: planted-shortcut style probes: stuffing probes place the cue inside a negation, paraphrase probes state the requirement without the cue

ablation_negation_guard.reading: a negation guard removes every surface false positive but raises the miss rate to one, so cue matching cannot recover requirement satisfaction stated in other words

consequence: cue-matching coverage is rejected as the primary deterministic endpoint
the variance components measured in the 32-episode block were computed on this invalid endpoint and are void as an allocation basis until recomputed on a valid one
the human-anchored calibration set is now load-bearing rather than optional, because a valid endpoint requires verification rather than matching
claim_scope: instrument validity only; no treatment effect is involved
